caseName: Board of the Black River Regulating District v. Adirondack League Club
caseNameFull: Board of the Black River Regulating District v. Adirondack League Club
attorneys: Arthur E. Sutherland for appellant. Charles H. Tuttle for appellee. Paul E. Brown filed a brief for the City of Watertown, New York, as amicus curiae, supporting appellant.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Court of Appeals of New York.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed on the ground that the judgment rests on an adequate non-federal basis. Rule .16 (b) of the Rules of this Court.
